scope: Optimizer-independent NoRIS upper bound for the actual binary input groups and all72 source NoRIS ordinates per language
source_unit_caveat: Source EPS prints W while implementation uses noise-normalized I/N. Source ordinate comparison is conditional on identifying these scalar grids, not proof that the original W input violates the bound.
mathematical_bound_assumptions: nonnegative MR powers and channel variances
denominator at least positive noise plus GEO interference
theorem_derivation: n_u <= max_j B_ju * L_u; den_u >= offset_u; t <= n_u/den_u implies L_u >= t*offset_u/max_j B_ju; sum_u L_u <= I.
conclusion: For the reported above-bound ordinates, no optimizer on these fixed inputs can reproduce the supplied source curve. Source-conforming physical coefficients remain unresolved; this is not a contradiction of the author paper under its unrecovered inputs.
